chose: The essay's question scene sets the ticket's program at the dives' size (0.62em) while it fits, and smaller in hundredths of an em for a longer program, down to the size that holds 25 lines (0.44em, about 13 px in the 1080p frame). The columns go from 1fr:1fr to 3fr:2fr, so the ticket's words get the width the 40-column code doesn't need. A title, spec, figures or points too long for the words' column is refused when the routine writes the week (questionFit, beside pointsFit), while it can still shorten them, and again in essayFit.
options: Shrink the program's type with its line count, down to what 25 lines need, and widen the words' column (3fr:2fr)
Keep the code at 0.62em and give the question scene two frames, the ticket's words then its program
Keep the code at 0.62em and cut it off past about 17 lines, with a note that the rest is in the week

gray: The owner will see the type: a 25-line program is drawn at about 13 px in the 1080p frame, against the 18 px of a dive's code. Two frames would keep it larger but add a scene, which changes the essay's script and timing; cutting it off would hide the program the owner answered; a lower cap would refuse programs the phone already holds. No check or earlier call settles which of these the owner prefers.
